rationale: The current 8.8 aggregate Premier Triage and Response row says Cloud Platform 10.2.x+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The detailed 8.8 guide and separate 8.7 guide give Cloud Platform 10.2+ and ES 8.7+; the task chain includes assistant enablement, paired SOAR, investigation visibility, existing findings with triage results, inherited connector access and granular asset permissions where configured. First-ten, approximately 200-per-tenant-per-day and frontier-model limitations remain task-scoped. CMP has Platform 10.4.x+, ES 8.8+ and Cloud Connect 2.0. The current exact setup page returned 404 directly; the official indexed section also names SAIA 2.4+, while the 2.3.6 exact known issue describes Cloud Connected support as planned for 2.4.0. The current Premier table/task wording does not retain the historical Essentials/Triage wording. The 8.8 English release page establishes November 4 GA; the exact October Controlled Availability passage is unavailable. Exact pairing, rollout, entitlement and customer authorization are outside this assessment.

exclusions: The exact scope in cited public evidence governs. No tenant access, entitlement or authorization is inferred.

remainingConcerns: Confirm the unresolved distinction detailed in this assessment using the exact official source scope.
